edit.description: the pending-manifest check raises manifest.rejected-collection from Manifest::rejected_collections, under the declared mode
a pending write of a collection of the wrong JSON type

summary: The guard judges a pending manifest write's wrong-typed collection with check's own rejected-collection finding, so the write is held as check would hold it

per.section: The placements and their enforcement modes

acceptance: a PreToolUse write of `"mcpServers": []` to a represented manifest draws manifest.rejected-collection at the declared mode; cargo test green
tests: guard raises the rejected collection finding for a pending manifest write of the wrong JSON type
notes: From notes/COLLECTION-OF-THE-WRONG-TYPE-IS-A-FINDING: install.rs parses through Manifest::parse but never reads rejected_collections. Same seam as the shipped unparseable-write refusal (GUARD-UNPARSEABLE-MANIFEST-WRITE-REFUSAL).
